metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures in the Arabian Sea reach at least 30 degrees Celcius in June of 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about sea surface temperatures in the Arabian Sea reaching at least 30°C in June 2023. For this, I need to: 1. Use a sea surface temperature dataset - MODIS Terra or Aqua would be good choices 2. Define the Arabian Sea region (approximate polygon) 3. Filter for June 2023 4. Check if collection has data 5. Calculate mean SST and check if it's >= 30°C 6. Handle potential issues like no data, no valid pixels, etc. I'll use MODIS Terra Sea Surface Temperature (MOD28) which has daily SST data. For the Arabian Sea, I'll define a polygon that covers the main Arabian Sea region. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const arabianSea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[50, 25], [78, 25], [78, 5], [50, 5], [50, 25]] ]); const startDate = '2023-06-01'; const endDate = '2023-07-01'; const threshold = 30; // 30°C threshold // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Sea Surface Temperature const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD28') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(arabianSea); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = sstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 2023 SST Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create monthly composite and calculate mean SST const monthlySST = sstCollection.mean(); // Calculate pixel count to check for valid data const pixelCount = monthlySST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: arabianSea, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean SST const meanSST = monthlySST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: arabianSea, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean SST: ${meanSST ? meanSST.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'}°C`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanSST === null || meanSST === undefined || isNaN(meanSST)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (meanSST >= threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
